action.description: Tool identifier shown to the person and available for reporting by the host.

approve-label.description: Verb or short phrase that describes what approval does, such as "Send email".

approved-label.description: Localized outcome text when the host marks the request approved.

consequence.description: Cost or irreversible effect to read before deciding, displayed as a warning note.

denied-label.description: Localized outcome text when the host marks the request denied.

deny-label.description: Verb or short phrase for refusal, such as "Keep draft".

expired-label.description: Localized outcome text when the host marks the request expired.

heading.description: Question naming the proposed action. Provide it before asking for a decision.

remember.description: Offers an unchecked preference limited to this action in the current conversation.

remember-label.default: 'Allow this action for the rest of this conversation'
remember-label.description: Localized conversation permission label. Name the specific permission when possible.

resolved-at.description: Display-ready, localized resolution time from the host, if known.

resolved-by.description: Display-ready name of the person or service that resolved the request, if known.

state.description: Host-controlled outcome. Resolve after recording a decision or expiring the request.

tone.description: Use danger when approval is destructive. Unknown values use neutral.

--ki-confirmation-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop effect behind the confirmation.

--ki-confirmation-bg.description: Solid raised background of the confirmation prompt and summary.

--ki-confirmation-bg-image.description: Optional image painted over the solid confirmation background.

--ki-confirmation-border-width.description: Stroke width of the confirmation boundary.

--ki-confirmation-inline-gap.description: Space between text and controls in a row.

--ki-confirmation-padding.description: Space between the prompt's edge and its content.

--ki-confirmation-radius.description: Corner radius of the confirmation surface.

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-surface-primary-med-em.description: semantic color for surface primary med em.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-family-mono.description: semantic font family for typography family mono.

--ki-typography-line-height-para.description: semantic dimension for typography line height para.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-body-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 2.

--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size.description: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.

component.description: An inline prompt for a decision about a proposed assistant action.

ki-approve.description: Explicit approval, with the conversation preference at the time of the decision.

ki-deny.description: Explicit refusal of the pending request.

focusPrompt.description:
Moves focus to the pending group and reports success. Call only when the
host knows the person was waiting for this request. A focused editor keeps
its focus, including editors inside open shadow roots.

group.description: The painted, labelled prompt or outcome surface.

remember.description: The label of the conversation preference checkbox.

approvedLabel.description: Localized outcome text when the host marks the request approved.

deniedLabel.description: Localized outcome text when the host marks the request denied.

denyLabel.description: Verb or short phrase for refusal, such as "Keep draft".

expiredLabel.description: Localized outcome text when the host marks the request expired.

remember.description: Offers an unchecked preference limited to this action in the current conversation.

rememberLabel.default: 'Allow this action for the rest of this conversation'

resolvedBy.description: Display-ready name of the person or service that resolved the request, if known.

slots.description:
Details the person needs to make the decision. Use readable text or
semantic markup such as a description list.
